frequency_question: How often do states sign successor water treaties before legacy treaty expiration when both have institutional capability and stated continuity goals?
membership_rule: Includes major bilateral river sharing treaties undergoing expiration and renegotiation between federal governments; excludes unilateral abrogations or cases lacking functioning joint river commissions.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty implementation and continuous operation
Canada-US Columbia River Treaty regime reviews and negotiations
India-Bangladesh Ganga Water Treaty initial signing
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase updates
Botswana-Namibia Okavango River Basin Commission operational updates

coverage_note: 6 named benchmark cases of major transboundary water treaty renewals under established joint river bodies.
known_gaps: Excludes minor technical protocol amendments that do not rise to the level of a formal successor treaty.
skeleton: Not applicable; direct case enumeration used.
validity_reason: Bilateral hydro-diplomacy norms and joint river commission structures evolve slowly over decades.
